# Agility CMS

Agility CMS is a headless content management system that allows developers to build and manage digital experiences across various platforms.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/agility-cms/.

## Actions

- **Get Content Item** (read-only): Fetch details of a content item by content id.
- **Get Content List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of content items by reference name.
- **Get Content Models** (read-only): Retrieve content models and page modules.
- **Get Page** (read-only): Retrieve details of a page, including metadata, content zones, and components.
- **Get Page Modules** (read-only): Retrieve all page modules defined in the agility instance.
- **Sync Content Items** (read-only): Retrieve all content items in a paged format with sync tokens.
- **Sync Pages** (read-only): Retrieve all page items in paged format with sync tokens.
- **Get Authors** (read-only): Retrieve all authors from an agility cms instance.
- **Get Categories** (read-only): Get all categories.
- **Get Logs** (read-only): Retrieve sync items (logs) from agility cms.
- **Get Sitemap Flat** (read-only): Retrieve the flat sitemap as a mapping of page paths to sitemap items.
- **Get Tags** (read-only): Get all tags.
